experiment: Explicitly fabricated fallible-record and copied-source sensitivity layer
genetic_reference: Public Ped-sim positive-sharing held-out features; model already trained on disjoint groups
limits: Record reliabilities/error rates are invented stress parameters, not empirical estimates.
Toy records directly state a cousin class; real genealogical records typically constrain ages/links indirectly.
Copying lineage is supplied to the grouped method in known-lineage scenarios; unknown lineage is deliberately ignored for fusion.
Fused models calibrate on nominal single-copy records only; shifted scenarios have no coverage guarantee.
Verification oracle perfectly reveals claim correctness. This does not establish real-world next-record utility or optimality.
Information-gain selection is existing methodology; no novelty claim.
No extension has been connected to production Kinfold.
